summary.description: One sentence on the overall state of the change. No praise, no restatement of what the code does.

severity.description: P0 data loss, security hole, or breakage on the common path. P1 wrong under a realistic input. P2 maintainability, missing test, contract smell. P3 nit.

line.description: Line in the new version of the file; 0 when not attributable to one line.

title.description: The defect in under twelve words.

failure.description: Concrete inputs or state leading to the wrong behaviour.

fix.description: The change that resolves it, in one or two sentences.

confidence.description: confirmed when the material on hand proves the defect; unverified when it is suspicion needing evidence not supplied.

evidence_needed.description: For unverified findings only: what would settle it.
